html:
A German car maker founded in 1937 by the Nazi state to build a cheap "people's car", which became the Beetle, one of the best selling cars ever made.

Hitler wanted a car that ordinary German families could afford, like Ford's Model T in America. Ferdinand Porsche designed it, and a vast factory was built at a new town, today's Wolfsburg. Hundreds of thousands of Germans paid into a savings scheme for a car, but almost none got one. In the Second World War the plant made military vehicles instead, using forced labourers and prisoners.

After the war the British army took over the bombed factory and restarted production. The Beetle became the symbol of West Germany's economic miracle. It sold worldwide, became a cult car in the United States, and production carried on in Mexico until 2003, with over 21 million made.

Volkswagen grew into one of the largest car groups in the world, owning brands such as Audi, Porsche and Škoda. In 2015 it admitted cheating on diesel emissions tests, one of the largest scandals in the industry. Many of its workers came from the guest worker waves.
sum: A German car maker founded in 1937 by the Nazi state to build a cheap "people's car", which became the Beetle, one of the best selling cars ever made.
